name: How do I choose the right contractor for a bedroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful bedroom addition. Look for licensed, insured general contractors with specific experience in home additions. Request to see a portfolio of their previous work and ask for references from past clients. Ensure they provide a detailed, written proposal outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Effective communication and a clear understanding of your vision are also key indicators of a good fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with addition experience, good references, and a detailed proposal. Effective communication is also important.
